title: Bright Light Therapy Efficacy for Depressive Symptoms Following Cardiac Surgery or Acute Coronary Syndrome: Pilot Trial
brief_summary: Bright Light Therapy Efficacy for Depressive Symptoms Following Cardiac Surgery or Acute Coronary Syndrome: Pilot Trial (BEAM-P) is a randomized controlled trial (RCT) that seeks to assess the feasibility of conducting a full trial which would assess the efficacy of Bright Light Therapy (BLT) for improving depressive symptoms post-cardiac surgery or acute coronary syndrome.
condition: Depressive Symptoms Post Cardiac Surgery or Post Acute Coronary Syndrome
